Cheers,
Rafael

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] Could not determine data columns based on RepAvg !
parts:
Hi Rafael,

 

Check you individual names in the dart file (column header above the snp data after RepAvg. They need to be unique, so you need to edit them in your dart file (most likely in Excel).

 

 

 

One way to do is to copy those columns (in excel) (normally in row 5 or 6)

 

Transpose them (Control – Alt – V) into a new excel document which has a single column with header id, save as csv

 

Load in to R via read csv and then table that single column

 

 

Ind.names  <- read.csv(“yourexcelascsv.csv”)

 

table(Ind.names)

 

All the entries that have a 2 or more are duplicates and the names need to be changed.

 

 

Cheers, Bernd

parts:
Rafael

On rare occasions dart's output files can get messed up. Switch on
filters in excel and check that the numbers in the rep ave field make
sense.

Using the filters check the first and last column of your datafile has no
blanks or odd values (in the section that has the snp calls for your
samples).

Delete a few "blank" rows at the end of your file.

Try importing the single row file rather than the two row file (or visa
versa, I'm not sure which one you have tried).

Cheers
Peter

messages.subject: RE: [dartR] Re: Could not determine data columns based on RepAvg !
parts:
Hi Rafeal,

I guess I found the "problem". Your are from a country where the default in excel as a separator is a ; (colon) and not a , (comma).

This breaks the function. A simple way is either switch to English in your windows setting, or maybe easier, search replace ; with , after you saved you csv from excel.


e.g. using notepad (I assume you do not use the colon anywhere else in your names.


At least in the three lines you sent I see the colon.

*;*;*;*;*;*;*;*;*;*;*;


If you do not like this you could copy the gl.read.dart function and replace read.csv commands with read.csv2 (which has the colon as default).



Cheers, Bernd

Ps. Same in the german default setting.
